caption: The drawing features two detailed renderings of souvenir spoons, depicted in black and white pencil or ink on a light beige or off-white background. Each spoon is drawn from a top-down perspective, showing the intricate designs on their handles. The left spoon’s handle features a portrait of a man, ornate decorative elements, and some text at the top, with a subtle indentation inside the bowl. The right spoon’s handle shows a building, a scene with a seated figure, and accompanying decorative motifs, with a smooth, reflective bowl. At the bottom right of the drawing, there is an inset that displays a side profile of a single spoon, emphasizing the curvature of the handle and the shape of the bowl. The drawing is framed within a rectangular border, and text at the bottom left reads “Westchester County” while at the bottom right it says “Drawn by Wm P. Sherwood.” The overall composition is clean, focusing on the spoons’ details and shape.
title: Silver Spoon
